M1017.name: User Training
M1017.description: Train users to recognise social engineering and to avoid storing credentials in plaintext files.

M1018.name: User Account Management
M1018.description: Limit which accounts can create services, scheduled tasks, or modify security settings.

M1022.name: Restrict File and Directory Permissions
M1022.description: Apply least-privilege permissions so users cannot modify protected files or security tool directories.

M1024.name: Restrict Registry Permissions
M1024.description: Restrict write access to registry keys controlling services, startup, and security software policy.

M1025.name: Privileged Process Integrity
M1025.description: Enable protected process light (PPL) for LSASS so its memory cannot be read by user-mode tools.

M1026.name: Privileged Account Management
M1026.description: Enforce least privilege and limit the number of accounts holding local administrator rights.

M1027.name: Password Policies
M1027.description: Enforce strong password length and complexity, and prohibit credential reuse across systems.

M1028.name: Operating System Configuration
M1028.description: Harden OS settings to restrict account creation and unauthorised autostart entries.

M1029.name: Remote Data Storage
M1029.description: Forward logs to a remote server or SIEM so local deletion does not destroy the evidence.

M1030.name: Network Segmentation
M1030.description: Segment the network to limit how much of the environment a single host can enumerate.

M1032.name: Multi-factor Authentication
M1032.description: Require a second authentication factor so a guessed or stolen password is not sufficient.

M1036.name: Account Use Policies
M1036.description: Set account lockout thresholds and login attempt limits to break brute-force attempts.

M1038.name: Execution Prevention
M1038.description: Use application control (e.g. WDAC or AppLocker) to block unapproved interpreters and proxy binaries.

M1042.name: Disable or Remove Feature or Program
M1042.description: Remove or constrain PowerShell where it is not required, and enable Constrained Language Mode.

M1043.name: Credential Access Protection
M1043.description: Enable Credential Guard to isolate LSASS secrets from the rest of the operating system.

M1047.name: Audit
M1047.description: Audit autostart locations, scheduled tasks, and file shares regularly for unexpected entries.

M1049.name: Antivirus/Antimalware
M1049.description: Use signature and heuristic scanning to detect obfuscated, packed, or encoded payloads.

M9001.name: Detection-Only Guidance (team-defined)
M9001.description: MITRE ATT&CK lists no preventive control for this technique, since the activity is indistinguishable from normal system use. Monitor instead: enable process command-line auditing and alert on unusual enumeration sequences.
